verdict.rationale: Wise documents a balance-statement API that returns statements in accounting-friendly formats (JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), so a developer can programmatically view transaction data for bookkeeping and reconciliation. However, the evidence shows no dedicated accounting API for managing that data: nothing on writing or categorizing ledger entries, reconciliation, or syncing to accounting software. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting/ledger API, write or manage operations on accounting data (categorization, reconciliation, sync), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
